description: This file defines a configuration class for proxying and transforming chat requests from OpenAI's `/v1/chat/completions` endpoint to a custom LLM service called litellm_proxy. It includes methods for model handling, API key management, request transformation, and proxy usage decision logic.

classes.name: LiteLLMProxyChatConfig
classes.description: A subclass of OpenAIGPTConfig that adds support for proxying chat models through litellm_proxy, including methods for parameter mapping, model retrieval, and request transformation.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Extends the supported OpenAI parameters with additional parameters specific to litellm.

methods.name: dict _map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters, handling special cases such as 'thinking'.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Retrieves the API base and key, potentially from secrets.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of models available through the proxy, prefixing them with 'litellm_proxy/'.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Returns the API key, possibly from secrets.

methods.name: _should_use_litellm_proxy_by_default( litellm_params: Optional[LiteLLM_Params] = None, )
methods.description: Determines if the litellm proxy should be used by default based on settings and parameters.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str,Optional[str],Optional[str]] litellm_proxy_get_custom_llm_provider_info( model: str, api_base: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Provides information to force using the litellm proxy for a specific model, returning model info, provider, and API credentials.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List["AllMessageValues"], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Returns the request payload without modification.

methods.name: dict async_transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List["AllMessageValues"], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the request payload without modification.
